svg.title: AI Automation for Lead Research
svg.desc: Seven-stage sieve cascade workflow for lead research: ICP criteria trigger a four-stage narrowing sieve cascade where Perplexity and LinkedIn sweep companies, off-fit records fall off the sides, surviving companies are fit-checked, Claude identifies decision-makers, a data provider API verifies details and deduplicates, a human spot-checks sample rows, and the clean table delivers to Google Sheets or CRM.
